jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE hand-painted matte 2D game sprite animation sheet. Identity preservation and exact same style as supplied Marko references are the highest priority. Pure flat #FF00FF MAGENTA background everywhere outside subject, no magenta costume, no gradients, no shadows/scenery, no gridlines, labels/text or borders. Every full figure, cape and weapons safely INSIDE OWN SQUARE CELL with20px emptygutters. Consistent anatomical body/head size in every pose; never enlarge crouches or normalize poses independently. Final512x512 cells with groundy487; idle anatomical standingheight383px, zoom EXACTLY marko-idle-2. Additional neutral standing calibration MUST be same Marko scale across sheet. EXACT SAME MARKO KRALJEVIC as references1and2, NOT a new design: same strong adult Balkan face, heavy BLACK MOUSTACHE and short black beard, same swept-back shoulder-length BLACK HAIR, same broad torso/anatomy. Same RED CLOAK with GOLD EMBROIDERED HEM and round gold shoulder clasp, brown LAMELLAR ARMOR, IVORY SHIRT with RED embroidered cuffs/hem, dark trousers, same tall BROWN LEATHER BOOTS and wide belt. No helmet/crown, no new armor/color/face. Right-facing. ONE long CURVED SERBIAN SABRE, matte steel blade, ornate TRIPLE GOLD HILT/GUARD with THREE DISTINCT small JEWELS (one set in each gold guard ornament), black leather grip. Only ONE blade and ONE handle, not three swords. BLACK LEATHER SCABBARD with GOLD fittings suspended at LEFT HIP, and his familiar SPIKED MACE hangs from same LEFT BELT side whenever sword is held. Keep identical sabre/three gemstones/scabbard/mace across all cells. No weapon glints, painted trails or magic effects. EXACT4COLUMNS x2ROWS equalSQUARECELLS rowmajor. FIRST6cells animation. Cell7 EXTRA SCALECALIBRATION: neutral UPRIGHT fullstanding Marko same proportions as referenceidle, sabrelow atside (or sheathed), armslow, no raisedweapon, head-to-boots383px target. Remainingcells EMPTY MAGENTA. 1 stands holding SPIKED MACE in right hand, sabre SHEATHED left;2 bringsmace tolefthip belt hook;3 mace attachedbelt, right hand reaches across to GOLD SABREHILT;4 draws blade halfway from BLACK SCABBARD heldleft hand;5 fully unsheathes sword forward;6 raises sword ready infront body. OnlyONE mace andONE sabre eachframe; mace alwaysbelt after3. Cape/face unchanged, real hand transitions.
